purpose: Define XiaoE-owned identity and authorization boundaries before runtime auth migration.

owner.description: Primary XiaoE owner with full management authority.

operator.description: Trusted operator/developer for day-to-day project management.

authorization_rules: Authentication proves identity; authorization decides allowed actions.
XiaoE identity must remain separate from Evolution Voucher Admin, Partner and Staff business roles.
High-impact actions require explicit confirmation and may require step-up authentication in future.
No service-role key or provider secret may be exposed in frontend code.
AI Router model calls must use a backend-only interface.
Project access must be derived from XiaoE authorization, not from UI visibility alone.
migration_gates: Create a XiaoE-owned authentication and authorization source of truth.
Verify owner login and session handling.
Verify role-based authorization independently from Evolution Voucher business roles.
Connect XiaoE Control UI to XiaoE authorization.
Connect AI Router through backend-only authorized endpoints.
Only after verification, retire Evolution Supabase identity dependency from XiaoE UI.
